[web - flash] Robot Unicorn Attack - an endless runner with... well, this game is not famous for its gameplay

Adult Swim has a wealth of creative flash games. There are so many to discuss, but Robot Unicorn Attack is their most famous and it has nothing to do with the gameplay, which is a completely standard endless runner. What makes Robot Unicorn Attack unique is the fantasy visuals and the way in which they combine with the single song soundtrack. Really though, it's the song. The song completely makes this game, integrating into the experience in a way that even something like Guitar Hero, a game solely about music, can't match.

I'm going to let someone else describe the experience with a picture: link

I don't know where that's from originally, but probably 4chan. So, what is the song? It's Always, by Erasure. Video here but I suggest that you play the game at least a little before you watch the video. The video is also fantastical, and not bad, but it's also kinda weird and it doesn't inspire the same kind of unabashed joy that you get from leaping unicorns and colorful fairies and playful dolphins.

I've linked the flash version of the game but, personally, I like the Android version better. It lets you turn off the sound effects, so nothing interrupts the music.
